# DRL-001: Initialize repository and protected branches

## Metadata

- Milestone: M1 Repository Online and Trusted
- Labels: `program`, `governance`
- Owning mission: 00 Program Director
- Evidence owner: Program Director
- Requirement IDs: `DRL-SYS-010`, `DRL-OSS-001`, `DRL-OPS-001`
- Dependencies: none
- Director decisions: `DIR-001` (confirm owner/slug)
- Public contract impact: NONE
- Risk class: governance
- Data classes: none

## User / research value

Creates a trustworthy remote home so sequential agents and contributors share one
protected source of truth instead of ad-hoc forks.

## Controlling documents

- `DIRECTORS_MEMO.md` (DIR-001, RES-010)
- `AGENTS.md` §2–3
- `docs/00-program/FIRST_SPRINT_PLAN.md`
- `agents/SEQUENTIAL_EXECUTION_PLAN.md` (integration branch policy)

## Problem

`main` exists and a remote is present, but `integration/v1`, branch protection,
and a confirmed repository identity are not yet recorded as operating evidence.

## Scope

### In scope

- Confirm or document GitHub owner/slug against DIR-001
- Create `integration/v1` from current foundation tip
- Protect `main` (and preferably `integration/v1`) against force-push / unreviewed merges
- Record rules in the worklog / handoff

### Out of scope

- Cloud project creation
- Product feature implementation
- Changing Laboratory Bible identity

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Director confirms repository identity (or explicitly defers with Memo update)
- [ ] `integration/v1` branch exists on origin
- [ ] `main` protection rules captured (required PR, required CI when available)
- [ ] WORKLOG reservation notes the branches
- [ ] No credentials committed

## Verification plan

```bash
git fetch origin
git branch -r | grep integration/v1
gh api repos/<owner>/<repo>/branches/main/protection
```

Manual: screenshot or JSON of protection settings attached to this issue.

## Security / privacy / licensing / cost

- No secrets in repo
- Public vs private visibility must match Director intent
- Cost: GitHub Actions minutes only

## Rollback

Delete unused `integration/v1` if created in error; revert protection settings via GitHub UI. No data migration.

## Evidence required for closure

Protection JSON/screenshot, branch list, Memo note for DIR-001, WORKLOG entry.
